messages:
Anya (PM): Pushed a new figma frame for the autoscale panel — can people 👀 for UX + copy? Link: https://www.figma.com/file/... (frame: Autoscale v4)

Michael (Design): Nice, I like the compact layout. Quick notes: move Min/Max to left column, put Burst toggle to the right with a small 'burst capacity' label. Current 'min/max' label reads ambiguous when min==max.

Ram (Eng): backend note: we need to keep pool id mapping visible. If user picks a GPU pool, UI must show pool name + capacity headroom. E.g., `{"min":1,"max":8,"burst":true,"pool":"gpu-pool-2","slo_percent":95}`

Anya (PM): Good catch @Ram. Can we show a tiny badge next to pool with 'est. available nodes: 4'?

Michael (Design): Yeah — use a compact chip: 'gpu-pool-2 · 4 nodes'. Also suggest showing per-pool median latency so users can pick by SLO.

Olivia (A11y): A few a11y nits: 1) SLO slider doesn't announce value on focus. Need aria-valuenow/aria-valuetext. 2) Contrast: the slider handle (#7bb7ff) fails AA on white. Make it darker and add focus ring. 3) Ensure the burst toggle is keyboard operable and has an accessible name.

Ram (Eng): Implementation note: SLO slider maps to `target_success_rate` in the API. We can expose keyboard arrows to +/- . Also we should clamp max to available pool capacity to avoid invalid submissions.

Michael (Design): Copy suggestions: - change 'Burst' tooltip to 'Temporary CPU/GPU burst for short spikes (billed at usage rate)'. - change 'Guardrails' heading to 'Safety guardrails' and add a one-liner: 'Automatic fallback when limits are hit'.

Anya (PM): Love the copy tweak. Also want a visual guardrail indicator when SLO < 90%: small orange pill 'At risk' with hover explanation.

Olivia (A11y): Also: ensure all controls have visible focus order and that disabled states explain why (e.g., 'Max locked by org quota'). Use role="status" for live updates when pool headroom changes.

Ram (Eng): Dev follow-ups: 1) Dropdown should include metrics: nodes, free_gpus, median_latency. 2) Add tooltip icon next to Min/Max: 'min = always reserved; max = autoscale ceiling'. 3) API validation must return helpful errors.

Michael (Design): Small UI nit: Min/Max input step should be 1 GPU, not decimals. And when min==max, replace slider with a 'Fixed capacity' badge to reduce confusion.

Anya (PM): Action items: Michael to update mocks, Olivia to run a quick keyboard/a11y checklist on the new frame, Ram to spec API changes and validation messages. I'll compile a doc for PM review.

deploy-bot: new design file uploaded by Michael (Design): link preview — figma.com/... :rocket:

Michael (Design): Thanks — I'll update the figma and ping when ready. :thumbsup:

Olivia (A11y): I'll test keyboard flow on Friday and post checklist results.

Ram (Eng): I'll draft the API contract and sample error responses by EOD Monday.

Anya (PM): Perfect. Thanks team! :clap:
